datePicker.$description: A single-date picker — a Select-style trigger (calendar icon + formatted date + chevron) that opens a month-grid calendar popover. Its driving use case is the message Expiration date ('Aug 15, 2026 ▾'), replacing the display-only trigger the composers used before. The trigger reuses the locked-in form-field recipe (surface.dim fill + hairline border → strong on hover → focus blue); the panel floats on the native Popover shell (border + shadow.sm). The calendar inside is the shared Calendar component (calendar.tokens.json, mode single) — header, grid and day states live there, not here; this file only owns the trigger and the popover panel. Supports min / max (earlier / later days disabled). Pairs with TimePicker as one joined date + time field.

value.$description: 14px, same as Select — the trigger is a button that opens a popover, never a text field, so the iOS focus-zoom rule (16px) doesn't apply.

placeholderColor.$description: 'Select date' before anything is picked — the same role as Select's placeholder.
